components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The solid recruiter-path action used in the hero.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; gap:13px; padding:13px 19px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-ink); color:white; font:700 15px Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background:var(--color-signal); color:var(--color-ink); transform:translateY(-3px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-blue-deep); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: A quieter action with a structural underline and directional arrow.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; gap:9px; border-bottom:1px solid currentColor; color:var(--color-ink); font:700 16px Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:gap 240ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-text-link:hover { gap:14px; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-blue-deep); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Skill Chip
components.description: A compact technical label used only inside expanded expertise rows.
components.css: .ds-skill-chip { display:inline-flex; padding:9px 13px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--color-signal); color:var(--color-ink); font:600 11px/1 JetBrains Mono,monospace; }

components.description: The persistent conversation action in desktop and mobile navigation.

components.name: Contact Orb
components.description: The circular final action that closes the page with one decisive object.
components.css: .ds-contact-orb { display:flex; width:240px; aspect-ratio:1; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:24px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--color-signal); color:var(--color-ink); font:800 17px Archivo,Arial,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 450ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 280ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-contact-orb:hover { background:var(--color-blue); color:white; transform:scale(1.06) rotate(-3deg); } .ds-contact-orb:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-signal); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview: The interface behaves like a system diagram brought to life. A saturated blue first screen carries Nazar's name, role, and portrait while orbit lines and technical markers create controlled movement around the person at the centre. The layout then becomes quieter and more linear as evidence accumulates. The visual voice is engineered, kinetic, and assured. Large Archivo typography provides the confidence of the reference sites, while JetBrains Mono labels add technical precision only where metadata benefits from it. The system explicitly rejects generic developer portfolio templates, decorative glassmorphism, terminal-themed dark interfaces, and repetitive card grids. Motion explains space and hierarchy. Pointer parallax is confined to the hero, image zoom belongs to the portrait story, the credential rail enters horizontally, and the contact orb arrives as a distinct object. Every movement has a static reduced-motion equivalent.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated blue world creates the first impression.
Oversized type remains readable, direct, and capped at 6rem.
Evidence becomes more structured as the visitor scrolls.
Lime signals interaction and motion without flooding the page.
Flat surfaces rely on overlap, scale, and contrast for depth.

rules.name: The Drenched First Screen Rule
rules.body: The hero is fully committed to Electric Blue. Do not dilute it with floating white cards or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Lime Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime marks motion, focus, selection, or action. It never becomes a general background theme.

rules.name: The One Shout Per View Rule
rules.body: One display statement dominates a viewport. Supporting text steps down clearly and never competes through scale.

rules.name: The Hard Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type never exceeds 6rem and letter spacing never tightens beyond -0.04em.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs a wide soft shadow to feel important, the hierarchy is wrong. Change scale, placement, or color instead.

rules.name: The Flat Credential Rule
rules.body: Credential objects sit directly on blue with a paper fill and 12px corners. Hover movement is short and never paired with a decorative border.

dos: Do make the role, current company, and engineering value visible on the first screen.
Do let Electric Blue carry a large surface instead of using it as a small accent.
Do use verified outcomes, dates, roles, and credential links as primary evidence.
Do vary motion by purpose: orbit in the hero, zoom on imagery, horizontal entry for rails, and object scale for the contact action.
Do let direct user input take priority over automatic movement.
Do preserve WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible focus, keyboard access, reduced motion, and useful no-JavaScript content.
Do keep cards at 12px corners and reserve full pills for buttons, tags, and circular controls.
donts: Don't revert to generic developer portfolio templates, decorative glassmorphism, terminal-themed dark interfaces, repetitive card grids, or skill progress bars.
Don't use stock code imagery, gradient text, side-stripe accents, or wide decorative shadows.
Don't copy Nothin', PX Push, or Awwwards portfolio conventions literally. Use their confidence, scale, and spatial choreography as inspiration only.
Don't apply one identical fade-and-rise reveal to every section.
Don't hide content behind motion, JavaScript, hover, pointer precision, or color alone.
Don't add marketing buzzwords, inflated claims, or hiring copy that sounds arrogant.
